speaker: john_heminges
text: A man at the door brought my lord's leave for the jig. He did not bring a purse with it. I am not dressing the leave up into a payment.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the jig is left, and the nights are still not a receipt. We play the old one, and we jig when it is done. I am not writing either of those into a book in a doorway.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Nick. Under the note. I have said it since morning. Leave is not a pitch. Glad is not a pitch.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I have a verse. I am glad of it. I know the verse. I am not singing it in this yard to prove I know it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Keep it unknown until the hall. Under, when you come in. A palace is not the place you show a note because you are pleased.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: I have the burden with him. I know the beat I come in on. I am not going to look at him to borrow it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Cittern, Phillips. Boys on the burden. One verse, and no invention past it. My lord left a jig, not a new play, and I am not writing the new play with my feet.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Will gives the tale and comes off. I do not want a man behind the cloth spending the second act on his own fear. There is a chest if his hands need a thing to do. Garnish will have the chest.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: If a roll is lost I will help find it. I will not rehearse my nerves out loud while I do it. The tale is the tale. Younger than I am, and long enough.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Cups in their hands. That is the hall. I am not asking it to be the Theatre. We had the prayer this morning.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Two cloaks stay here. The count is tomorrow, in a light. Nobody packs a yeoman's property into a basket because a night has become exciting.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I can be glad and still wait. I am saying so now, before the gladness is in the room with the cittern.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Saying so is not singing. Stay on that side of it until I give you the beat, and then come in under.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: If the beat is mine I will take it. I do not need a speech about taking it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: No speech. Feet, and then stop. A jig that explains itself is a sermon, and the sermon was this morning.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Sam stays with Augustine. I am not putting a boy back on a floor. The floor had him last night, and it did not pay him in pearls.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Five pearls are not our business tonight. The button stays where it stayed, which is lost. I am walking over to give a tale, not to kneel.

speaker: john_heminges
text: No purse. The green has not grown one since midnight. Leave is a word. I have the word, and I have entered nothing. God keep you.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I will come in where Augustine puts me. I am glad. That is all I am bringing.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Bring the verse, and leave the gladness off the pitch. With me, both of you, when we cross.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Cross, then. I want a hall that has already laughed before I ask it to stamp. The old play can do that labour. I will take the easier job.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The old play, once. Then your job. I am not improving either of them in the doorway.

speaker: arthur_meeks
text: I have the burden. I do not need it tried in the yard.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I am not trying it. Glad is in me. It is not in the note yet.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then keep it there until the hall. Nothing is entered. Cross when the door is done with you.
